# Step 2.128: your name, your password, your email

## Layer 1, the name (builder 1)

Found (item 1):

- A new account is made with no name: the code proves the address, then `choosePassword`
  (`apps/web/src/server/sign-in/flows.ts`) or Google; the first request with that session
  links or makes the account in `identify` (`apps/web/src/server/database-ports.ts`,
  `accountOfSignIn`). The stand-in world does the same in `stand-in-ports.ts`.
- A person's own profile is a `profiles` row joined by `profile_access` with relation
  `self`, made once by `public.create_own_profile` (0012). The Admins page reads
  `accounts.display_name` (`access_list_names()`), not the profile.
- Every way in (league pages, admin actions, `/`, `/account`, invitations, the JSON API)
  reads the session through `ports.identify` (request-facts.ts). The gate stands there.

Done (commit 61af9e0d; T-445, T-446 in `decisions-pending`):

- Gate: `identify` (database-ports.ts, stand-in-ports.ts) refuses an account with no own
  profile with the account problem `name-needed`; every page already sends that to
  `/account`, which then draws the one name screen (NameScreen, with sign-out).
  `ports.ownName.accountOf` is the only read of the account before the gate.
- Commands `give-own-name.ts` (through `createOwnProfile`) and `change-own-name.ts`
  (core, people); queries `read-own-name.ts`, `rename-own-profile.ts` (also sets
  `accounts.display_name`, which the Admins page shows). Form: `own-name-form.tsx`,
  actions `server/sign-in/own-name-actions.ts` (change refreshes; a refusal keeps the text).
- Existing rows: the made-up database's seed members and the test copy's owner have a
  display name but no own profile, so they are asked once at their next sign-in (the
  lead's rule). The stand-in's made-up people count as named (T-446).
- Passed: core and database unit tests, database-ports and container tests (updated:
  linking is read before the gate), messages, role matrix, isolation coverage.

Left (not done, budget): the browser test of item 5; `sign-in-says-test` will now meet the
name screen after each sign-up and must answer it (not run); `fence-filter-check` did not
finish in 400 s; `npm run check` and the harmful-text test for the two new fields not run.
Layers 2 and 3 need nothing from this one.
